title: FR: upload and download xdrip config from / to central server
symptom: After a phone outage, the user had to manually restore the entire xDrip configuration (data collector, uploads, alarms, etc.), which was a lot of work. They want to store and restore the whole xDrip config (and possibly the whole database) on a central config server.
fix: The thread discusses implementing a WebDAV backup/restore feature. The user (gruoner) states they implemented a webdav upload/restore feature, and later a PR #2269 was opened. Additionally, xDrip can now create a backup on Google Drive and restore from it, but the user notes that doesn't address their need because they use an Android device without Google apps.
evidence_quote: i'm currently working on a webdav backup/restore feature (it's useless to upload all of xdrip's db entities (tables) to dedicated nightscout mongo-collections, so i will use the existing backup/restore functions and add just a webdav protocol handling).
